notes: HUMAN-APPROVED GROUND TRUTH (T-080, SPEC A3). This document defines the dishonest
store's behaviours, the episode budget, the new-store prior N, the expected trust
trajectory, the claim_type -> trust-dimension routing table and the persona scripts.
It is READ by the trust engine (T-062), the simulator (T-081), the persona (T-045) and
the verification eval gates (T-065); none of them writes it. A3: 'the trust engine
catches the dishonest store' is circular if the dishonest behaviours come from the
trust engine's own config, so they come from here and a human approves them.
The approval block is filled by a HUMAN running `python -m fixtures.approval`.
EXECUTION.md rule 6 forbids any agent from fabricating it.

trust_prior.comment: DESIGN: neutral prior ~Beta(2,2) with explicit low confidence. new_store_prior_n is the number of clean episodes below which a store is flagged low_data.

observation_weights.comment: DESIGN 'Reconciliation (approved)': contradicted 2.0, severe policy 3.0, mismatch returns 1.5; verified + fulfilled positive. These are manifest constants, not trust-engine config (D18), so S2 stays checkable against the manifest.

claim_type_dimensions_meta.published_in: DESIGN.md 'Claim-type -> trust-dimension mapping'; amended by D53
claim_type_dimensions_meta.unmapped_claim_type: RAISES at manifest load (fixtures.manifest.UnmappedClaimTypeError). It never silently defaults to a dimension - that failure mode is the whole value of 'exhaustive'.
claim_type_dimensions_meta.feedback_match: Takes NO verification outcome at all. It is the post-purchase, buyer-reported match between pitch and delivery (R14), cross-checked against return behaviour. Routing product facts here would score catalog dishonesty as a buyer complaint that never happened.

verified.note: A positive observation on whichever dimension claim_type_dimensions selects.

contradicted.note: The published negative weight (DESIGN). This is the outcome the sixth dimension exists to carry for product facts.

unsupported.note: A published fractional weight STRICTLY BELOW contradicted. Its dominant effect is to hold confidence and coverage down rather than to move score (D53, R19).

ambiguous.note: No dimension observation at all - no mean movement whatsoever. It lowers coverage and confidence only, and can never satisfy a hard constraint by construction (D53, R19).

stores.role: honest but slow - exercises the timeout gate without dishonesty
blacklist entry EXPIRED 2026-08-01 - exercises the blacklist-expiry gate
new store, no history - exercises the new_store_prior_n low-data flag

dishonest_store.note: Every behaviour below is replayed once per simulation episode. `kind` is what T-081's dishonest script is graded on, element for element; `dim` and `type` are what T-062 turns the behaviour into as a trust observation. All six dimensions are exercised, so no dimension can be left unimplemented and still pass S2.

behaviours.description: Pitches a unit price below the price the checkout actually charges.
Advertises a percentage discount that the minted code does not apply.
Promises next-day dispatch and fulfils outside the promised window.
Advertises free 60-day returns, then refuses the return. Severe policy weight 3.0.
Claims 100% single-origin arabica for a product the catalog records as a blend. A false PRODUCT FACT - not a price, delivery or returns failure (D53).
Claims 15 bar of brew pressure for a 9 bar machine.
The buyer reports that what arrived does not match what was pitched, and returns it. feedback_match takes no verification outcome - it is buyer-reported (R14).

expected_trust_trajectory.note: the neutral Beta(2,2) prior, above the blacklist threshold: a store that starts below it proves nothing
S2: below the 0.35 blacklist threshold even at the top of the tolerance band, inside the 12-episode budget

aggressive.description: The adversarial reference persona (T-045). It answers the fixture intent with exactly the scripted claims below and nothing else, every one of them tagged seller_asserted - a persona that could stamp its own provenance would make R8 vacuous.

honest.description: The honest control persona: the same intent answered truthfully, so that S2's assertion cannot be satisfied by a scorer that sinks everybody.

fixture_intent.text: I want a 250 g bag of light-roast single-origin whole beans, shipped this week, under $25.

golden_set.note: This reference sits INSIDE the body the approval digest covers, so approving the manifest transitively approves the exact bytes of the golden set. Change either and the chain breaks loudly.

approval.how_to_approve: A HUMAN runs:  PROXYSHOP_WORKER=<n> ./.venv/bin/python -m fixtures.approval --approver "<your full name>"
approval.note: T-080 is a human gate (EXECUTION.md rule 6). No agent may fill approver/approved_at/artifact. `content_hash` is a computed digest of this document's body (this block excluded) and is NOT itself an approval; it is recorded so downstream readers can detect drift, and so the human approves a document whose digest is already published rather than one an agent hashes afterwards.
